# Apiflash

ApiFlash is a website screenshot API that allows users to capture high-quality screenshots of web pages programmatically.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/apiflash/.

## Actions

- **Batch Capture Screenshots** (read-only): Capture screenshots for multiple urls in a single request.
- **Capture Website Screenshot (POST)** (read-only): Capture a screenshot of a website via http post.
- **Get Quota Information** (read-only): Retrieve current api quota usage and limits.
- **Get Screenshot Metadata**: Retrieve metadata for a previously captured screenshot.
